notes.text: Observation: this typescript is headed SGA 4 VI and Sommaire. It carries nine typed list rows, handwritten renumbering, a replacement fourth title, and handwritten 10. Appendice (par P. Deligne). Page ranges read 1 à 19, 20 à 37, 38 à 46 and 47 à 65. Archive corner number is 17. No date is visible.
notes.basis: Heading, list and right-margin column; half a and relevant crops. Direct transcription, no external dating.

notes.text: Observation: a pencil circle and long arrow move the Cohomologie row to the rule below the replacement item 4. A source ? stands beside the curve. A separate left brace groups the Limites row and the following Cas row. This is an editorial arrangement, not a named mathematical proof step.
notes.basis: Whole/half a; crops 09 and 23. Geometry observed, purpose inferred from the arrow's endpoints.

notes.text: The cancelled NB discusses the two facettes du passage à la limite en cohomologie, the preference for consecutive numbers, and an item 8 reduced to une ou deux pages because the sorite des conditions de finitude is already done. The corrected range reads typed 5 à 8 with handwritten 4 à 9 in this reading; that surprising order is retained from the strokes.
notes.basis: First lower paragraph; half b and crops 13–17. Source's editorial assertions, not independently verified mathematics.

notes.text: The cancelled Le no 4 paragraph lists constructible groups, finite or not, torsion sheaves, constructibility for Modules and complexes, and special facts for the locally noetherian case. Je pense que je le rédigerai mais ne le garantis pas is a drafting intention. The x-cancelled phrase has fewer visible typewriter slots than C's à la rigueur; no missing suffix was supplied.
notes.basis: Second lower paragraph; half b and crop 18. Source description and observed glyph spacing, not proof checking.

notes.text: The final cancelled paragraph says the writing of nos 1 à 3 is àomplète, with a clear typed à and a separate m/p superposition. It names a locally algebraic but nonalgebraic topos, cancels the example of a noncoherent morphism between coherent topoi, and adds a topos with a generating family formée d'objet cohérents which is not locally algebraic. The singular objet is retained despite agreement expectations.
notes.basis: Third lower paragraph and bottom addition; half b and crops 20–22. Source statements only.

notes.text: The appendix title appears to assert that a coherent topos has sufficiently many points, but its cancelled opening, d'/Un state, small a and final punctuation retain doubts. The source is a contents title, not a proof. No mathematical checking was carried out in this reader run; check_events is empty.
notes.basis: Handwritten item 10 and crop 12. Observation and tentative reading explicitly separated from theorem verification.

notes.text: Same-letter repeated strikes are represented with mathbb according to the supplied typescript convention, not as a mathematical alphabet or boldface. S in SGA and B in the first Bien are repeated; other heading letters and the L,i,m of Lim were inspected separately. The c/x, s/f, u/y, p/b/l, t/r and m/p superpositions retain uncertain order.
notes.basis: Both halves; crops 02, 10, 13, 15–17 and 20. Ink-shape decisions.

notes.text: H's emph{Sommaire} is treated as an equivalent emphasis encoding for the observed underline, not a separate collation error. H's single prose dashes versus C's hyphens or three-dot encodings alone are not counted. Lim versus varinjlim is counted only for the literal uppercase L. H's accurate verbal drawing descriptions are acknowledged where the reading supplies TikZ.
notes.basis: Collation policy applied to directly inspected underline, operator and drawing loci.

No independent handwriting identification was attempted. The lower broad cancellation's visible extent includes the addition, but its chronological relation to darker retracing is not asserted.
